summary: Form 8843 is the statement that students, teachers, researchers and trainees on F, J, M or Q visas, and their spouses and children, file with the IRS to explain why their days in the United States do not count toward U.S. tax residence. Each person files their own form for each year they were in the United States, even with no income, either attached to Form 1040-NR or mailed on its own.
